message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, red, bold capital letters. Below the title, smaller text reads "EDISI 22-28 JULI 2013". The main visual element is a close-up portrait of a man’s head and upper torso. His face and head are completely covered in an intricate, chaotic web of tangled, thin, copper-colored wires. Several small, gray and colored rectangular connector plugs protrude from the wire mesh on his cheeks, chin, and forehead. Underneath the wire texture, his facial features—eyes, nose, and mouth—are visible. He has dark hair, dark eyes, and a slight goatee. He wears a white, high-collared garment with a single dark button visible.

On the left side, bold black text reads: "LELET INTERNET MENTERI TIFATUL". Smaller text below it states: "Pengadaan Internet kecamatan oleh Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika bermasalah. Digerogoti kader partai." At the top, two smaller headlines read: "BALIK BADAN SAKSI DJOKO SUSILO" and "GERILYA MENGGERGAJI KHOFIFAH". The background is plain white with a vertical red stripe on the far left. A barcode and price information are in the bottom right corner.
